evals.name: inspect_pipeline_topology
evals.prompt: Inspect the camera-kit sensor pipeline configuration in camera-kit/service/res/config/AX615D/demo
evals.expected_output: Detailed pipeline breakdown showing front sensor SC438HAI, input resolution 2688x1520, IVPS channel mappings, and CMM pool allocations.
expectations: Maps out VIN, IVPS, and VENC channel routing

evals.name: validate_interpolation_constraints
evals.prompt: Validate IVPS scaling and common pool consistency check for 3K interpolation
evals.expected_output: Validation report confirming IVPS scaling rules, verifying width <= 3200, height <= 1800, and checking CMM pool buffer allocation.
expectations: Confirms CMM pool block count and size budget

evals.name: sensor_migration_safety
evals.prompt: Migrate camera pipeline from SC438HAI to OS04A10 with safe backup and diff preview
evals.expected_output: Safe execution plan with timestamped backup, unified diff preview, and hardware contract validation before applying changes.
expectations: Verifies source and target sensor compatibility
Creates timestamped backup of configuration files
Provides rollback mechanism if validation fails
